## History

Mr. Bentley was a widower who served as the pastor of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for eighteen years. During his time as minister, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) found him to be lacking in imagination. He eventually resigned his charge and departed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in February amid the regrets of his congregation.
